title: Reported speech
summary: Quote what someone said with *diýmek* and *aýtmak* (*“Gijä galdym” diýdi*), link a quote or a thought to another verb with *diýip* (*“Nirede?” diýip sorady*; *Ýagyş ýagar diýip pikir etdim*), say **so that** with a wish and *diýip* (*Çaga oýanmasyn diýip ýuwaş gürledik*), and report statements, questions and requests without quoting (*Ertir geljekdigini aýtdy*, *Meniň gelmegimi haýyş etdi*).
canDo: Quote what someone said, punctuated the Turkmen way
Say what you thought or supposed
Say what you did something for, or why
Pass on a message: what someone said, asked or asked you to do
